baseline.worktree: clean except intentionally ignored generated V3 data

architecture.request_path: exact anchor -> RaceState (Phase-4) -> SimulationState (R2) -> eligibility -> MonteCarloEngine (R5/R6) -> MonteCarloResult

run_semantics.one_simulation: one independent deterministically-seeded trajectory: SimulationState at checkpoint T evolved lap by lap by the R4 kernel with per-lap independent R3 residual draws until the leader completes scheduled_laps; terminal order from free-air (laps DESC, time ASC, driver_id ASC); exactly one winner per valid trial
run_semantics.stochastic: per-lap epsilon ~ empirical R3 quantile residual (Uniform(0,1) interpolated, bounded by observed support); median-centered, mean slightly positive, NOT recentered
run_semantics.fixed: starting state, pace anchor (circuit|era base + constructor offset), progress/degradation deltas from T, roster, scheduled distance, RNG streams
events_possible: pit stops with loss/compound transition when pits enabled
run_semantics.aggregation: integer position counts over valid trials; frequencies = counts / valid_count

input_contract.name: per-driver status
input_contract.conditioning: always ACTIVE from adapter; RETIRED refused

input_contract.name: R3 pace families (base, constructor offset, progress, degradation)
R3 pit families (stint, transitions, losses)
input_contract.conditioning: sampled on domain-separated streams; pits only

input_contract.name: NOT consumed
input_contract.conditioning: no winner model, no feature engine, no labels, no replay cache, no future rows (AST-pinned)

probability_semantics.ml: INDEPENDENT_BINARY per-driver winner probabilities; do NOT sum to 1; never renormalized
probability_semantics.mc: MONTE_CARLO_FREQUENCY over mutually exclusive simulated winners; sums to 1 by construction (one winner per valid trial; invariant-enforced)
prohibited: naive averaging of ML and MC
renormalizing ML scores into an MC distribution
treating ML and MC as interchangeable estimators

randomness.domain_separation: R6 pit/compound/loss/reliability streams use a 4th entropy word; R5 pace stream frozen
randomness.common_random_numbers: adopted with limitations (shared per-(seed,index) streams; not universal variance reduction after divergence)
randomness.parallelism_effects: none on science (per-simulation streams; chunk size operational only)
randomness.ordering_sensitivity: event order fixed: earliest next completion, driver_id tiebreak
randomness.nondeterminism: none found; runtime_s excluded from identity

race_agnosticism.specific_compounds: dry only; wet refused, not branched
race_agnosticism.pit_patterns: empirical behaviour model, no fixed patterns

supported_seasons.demo_cache_policy: retrospective_product through-2024; all replay seasons 2018-2024 eligible in principle

eligibility.classifier: RaceState -> from_race_state -> terminal check (leader>=scheduled) -> select_pace_parameters -> _validate_start_state; input validation only, no MC

stage_coverage.note: 492 adapter-level failures carry no stage (no fraction); eligibility decays with race progress as retirements accumulate

STALE_ROSTER_OBSERVATION.mechanism: a roster member's latest observation is older than 3.0 expected lap times
STALE_ROSTER_OBSERVATION.dominant_cause: factual pre-T retirements stop producing observations

UNSUPPORTED_TRACK_STATE.mechanism: anchor track_state is red_flag / yellow/safety_car/vsc/vsc_ending / null

WET_CONDITIONS.mechanism: rainfall=True weather or INTERMEDIATE/WET compound (dry-only kernel)

MISSING_DRIVER_OBSERVATION.mechanism: unobserved roster member (esp. frame 0) or missing pit count

MISSING_TYRE_STATE.mechanism: tyre_age null for a roster member at T

representative_failures.evidence: offenders match factual DNFs (6 retirements in results); observation ages thousands of seconds
rainfall=True mid-race; dry pace excludes wet laps
wholesale null tyre_life across checkpoints; zero-coverage race
track_state null at leader lap 2; all tyre ages null
lap-1 roster not yet fully observed

performance.note: 9 capable states (3 races x early/mid/late), seed 20240101, pits off; 0 invalid runs

precompute_estimate.storage_per_corpus: EXTRAPOLATED ~46MB payload (~20KB x 2274) plus envelope, ~50-100MB total

minimum: winner frequencies + driver identities (canonical driver_id order)

demo_architecture.flow: replay state -> cache key (race_id|frame_index|sim_version|param_hash|seed|n_runs) -> precomputed result -> frontend; unavailable states return explicit reason; no hidden live fallback
demo_architecture.generator: same frozen simulator code as local/Docker

local_docker_architecture.flow: Docker/local user -> race/checkpoint -> real simulator -> same schema as cached demo
local_docker_architecture.frontend_helpers: simulatorMachine.ts (no science; anchor mapping + display only)
local_docker_architecture.gap: no precompute/export endpoint yet; cache corpus does not exist; V3.2F work

v3_1_dynamics_audit.note: classification is audit judgement, not implementation; no dynamic enters the simulator in V3.2A

mc2_candidate_inputs.gap_slopes: overtake-pressure / variance modulation by closing rate; needs a traffic-interaction mechanism that does not exist today
mc2_candidate_inputs.pace_slopes: driver-specific pace anchor (replaces constructor-shared anchor); strongest structural gap (R4-I option C limitation)
mc2_candidate_inputs.traffic_persistence: interaction probability / free-air violation probability; new model family
mc2_candidate_inputs.follower_gap: follower-pressure variance or mistake probability; new model family
mc2_candidate_inputs.rule: no dynamic admitted without a named mechanism; classifier lift alone is insufficient

ml_simulation_firewall.current_coupling: none: simulator imports no prediction, model_lab, feature engine, labels, or replay cache (AST-pinned)
ml_simulation_firewall.default: simulation evolves state from empirical mechanics, never queries winner probability
ml_simulation_firewall.v3_1_model_role: must not become a hidden oracle without explicit experimental justification

temporal_safety.verdict: no same-race future leakage in simulator inputs
temporal_safety.state_T: RaceState is past-only synchronized observations <= T
temporal_safety.adapter: FACTUAL_AT_T only; no bypass to full D9 frame
temporal_safety.retirement: never inferred; stale states refused, not relabelled
temporal_safety.parameters: historical past races only (through_season window); backtest policy enforces through < target
temporal_safety.distinction: training-history evidence is not same-race future

simulated_events.retirement: NOT_SUPPORTED (V3.2: no; later phase needs hazard family; out of scope if unevidenced)

outcome_distribution_boundary.already_recorded: full per-driver position distributions + expected finish + bounded sample_orders in every MonteCarloResult

strategy_boundary.phase7_contract: paired.py run_baseline/run_intervention_arm over engine.run(collect_index_outcomes=True); same (seed,index) streams; reusable baseline arm

counterfactual_boundary.v3_2_provides: clean interface only: SimulationState is cloneable, Assumptions seam exists, intervention seam exists (strategy-owned)

uncertainty_boundary.v3_2_may_report: Monte Carlo sampling uncertainty only (MC standard error over frequencies)

demo_disclosure: Historical simulation results are precomputed for fast, reproducible demo playback. Clone the repository or run the Docker environment to execute simulations locally.

validation_strategy.precedent: R7 protocol r7-validation-v1 (evaluation only, frozen before scoring)
